summary: The three most important visible problems are: (1) cross_legged, where the skirt and petticoat intersect the folded legs and shoes, producing disconnected green and skin-colored patches across the lap; (2) sit_chair and sit_stand@36,54,60, where the skirt and petticoat form a broad, rigid, forward-facing shell instead of settling around the thighs; and (3) jump_tuck and high_kick, where the lifted legs drive a large section of the skirt into a rigid raised panel. The first is a clear intersection problem; the latter two are substantially explained by the disabled cloth physics and should be checked again with simulation enabled. Most visible body joints retain reasonable volume, and none of these sheets clearly demonstrates broken anatomy or an exploding mesh. Clip ratings cover the supplied samples only: they cannot establish smoothness or rule out popping between unsampled frames.

items.name: sit_chair
items.location: Skirt front, lap, and underside around the knees
items.issue: The skirt and petticoat rise into a broad, rigid shell that exposes the entire lining rather than settling across the lap, a conspicuous cloth deformation substantially attributable to the disabled simulation.

items.name: seiza
items.location: Front hem around the folded knees and ankles
items.issue: The front hem remains tented around the folded legs, with small green shoe or ankle details crowding the knee openings, although the visible knees retain their shape and the stiff cloth is consistent with physics being disabled.

items.name: kneel_one
items.location: Raised thigh and front skirt opening
items.issue: The raised thigh pulls a large skirt section into a stiff arch with an overly open lining, but the supporting and folded legs show no clear anatomical collapse.

items.name: cross_legged
items.location: Central lap and both folded legs
items.issue: The folded legs and shoes visibly intersect the skirt layers across the lap, leaving disconnected green and skin-colored patches and a sharply folded central cloth panel rather than a coherent covering.

items.name: deep_lunge
items.location: Front thigh, hip, and skirt underside
items.issue: The skirt follows the lifted thigh as a stiff canopy and exposes an unusually broad area of lining, an expected limitation of the unsimulated chains rather than a clearly broken hip or knee.

items.name: run_l
items.location: Skirt over the raised thigh
items.issue: The raised knee lifts a relatively rigid wedge of skirt and lining, while the visible leg bends and limb lengths remain plausible.

items.name: run_r
items.location: Skirt over the raised thigh
items.issue: The skirt forms a stiff shelf over the lifted thigh with limited independent drape, but no clear body penetration or joint collapse is visible at this scale.

items.name: jump_tuck
items.location: Entire front skirt and petticoat around the tucked thighs
items.issue: Both tucked legs carry the skirt into a broad, nearly vertical panel with an unnaturally rigid perimeter, a conspicuous no-physics cloth artifact without clearly demonstrated limb damage.

items.name: high_kick
items.location: Skirt surrounding the elevated leg
items.issue: The elevated leg raises most of the front skirt into a rigid sail with a large exposed lining, making the cloth deformation conspicuous even though the kick itself remains anatomically readable.

items.name: arms_crossed
items.location: Overlapping sleeves across the chest
items.issue: The inflated sleeves merge into a compressed central mass with little visible accommodation for their mutual contact, suggesting a small sleeve intersection rather than a body-joint failure.

items.name: hands_behind_head
items.location: Inner upper arms and sleeve roots beside the head
items.issue: The sleeve roots pinch into angular folds at the deeply bent arms, although the visible shoulders remain connected and no definite arm-through-head penetration is apparent.

items.name: hands_on_hips
items.location: Sleeve cuffs against the waist
items.issue: The cuffs terminate tightly against the waist and obscure the hands without a convincing contact fold, suggesting slight sleeve-to-bodice overlap.

items.name: hug_self
items.location: Sleeve overlap across the upper chest
items.issue: The two sleeves press into a single angular mass across the chest with a pinched central overlap, while the hands and exposed shoulders remain anatomically plausible.

items.name: lie_back_elbows
items.location: Skirt and lining surrounding the extended thighs
items.issue: The skirt retains a rigid bowl-like opening around the extended legs rather than falling with gravity, consistent with the disabled cloth simulation and without definite visible skin self-intersection.

items.name: look_over_shoulder
items.location: Back-hair tip on the left side of the front-view panel
items.issue: One trailing hair strand forms a conspicuous angular, nearly horizontal kink behind the arm, consistent with a rigid driven chain rather than a smoothly bending lock.

items.name: dance_heart
items.location: Hands against the crown and front hair
items.issue: The fingers partially disappear into the crown and fringe silhouette where the hands meet, suggesting a small hand-to-hair intersection.

items.name: run
items.location: Skirt hem above the alternating raised thighs
items.issue: The hem lifts in stiff sections over the alternating thighs instead of draping independently, but the sampled knees retain volume and the repeated start/end poses show no obvious deformation mismatch.

items.name: sit_stand
items.location: Front skirt and petticoat throughout the seated hold
items.issue: The seated phase exposes a broad, rigid lining shell that stands around the knees rather than settling over the lap, matching the static sit_chair problem and largely reflecting the disabled cloth simulation.

items.name: spin
items.location: Skirt circumference during the turn
items.issue: The flared skirt maintains a stiff platter-like profile with little local folding, although centrifugal flare is plausible and the adjacent samples at frames 5 and 6 show no obvious pop.

items.name: idol_dance
items.location: Skirt above the lifted thigh
items.issue: The lifted thigh raises a stiff wedge of skirt and lining as in run_l, while the closely spaced samples at frames 72 and 74 show no obvious deformation jump.
